# The Cohesive Tetrad: Jalan Menuju Kebenaran

Summary: Canonical public repository for The Cohesive Tetrad, an epistemic and ethical framework for truth governance built on Sabda, Logic, Qualia, and Mystica, verified on the surface of Akhlak.

Canonical sources:
- Repository: https://github.com/suratkiade/the-cohesive-tetrad
- DOI (OSF): https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/D5S7V

Key files:
- README.md (canonical overview)
- CANONICAL_INDEX.md (corpus index)
- manuscript/TCT_v1.0_canonical.md (book manuscript)
- journal/TCT_Journal_TruthGovernance_EN_v1.0_canonical.md (EN journal)
- journal/TCT_Jurnal_TataKelolaKebenaran_ID_v1.0_canonical.md (ID journal)
- semantic-defs/TCT_Canonical-Semantic-Definitions_ID-EN_v1.0.json (semantic kernel)
- semantic-defs/TCT_Canonical-Semantic-Definitions_ID-EN_v1.0.md (semantic definitions)

Languages: Indonesian (primary), English (secondary)
